summary:
If the int argument is 0, call_stack() returns an array of program filenames on the call stack, with the first one being the most recent (i.e. the currently running program).  If the int argument is 1, call_stack returns the objects in which that program is executing.  If it is 2, the name of the functions are returned.  If it is 3, the value of origin() in that frame is returned. If it is 4, the value will be the full file path and the line number.

When the argument is 0, call_stack() returns an array of program filenames on the call stack, with the most recent first (the currently running program). With 1 it returns the objects executing the program; with 2, the function names; with 3, the origin() value for each frame; and with 4, the full file path and line number.
details:
Example
[728|728]eval return call_stack()
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  "/tmp/debug_eval_file.c",
  "/cmds/cmd/eval.c",
  "/inherit/living.c"
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(0)
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  "/tmp/debug_eval_file.c",
  "/cmds/cmd/eval.c",
  "/inherit/living.c"
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(1)
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  /tmp/debug_eval_file ("/tmp/debug_eval_file"),
  /cmds/cmd/eval ("/cmds/cmd/eval"),
  /inherit/user5#2 ("杨宇(test)")
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(2)
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  "eval",
  "main",
  "command_hook"
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(3)
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  "call_other",
  "call_other",
  "driver"
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(4)
Result = ({ /* sizeof() == 3 */
  "/tmp/debug_eval_file.c:2",
  "/cmds/cmd/eval.c:23",
  "/inherit/living.c:56"
})
[728|728]eval return call_stack(5)
*First argument of call_stack() must be 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
